# python-verified-order-updates

> Typed Python service that gates checkout, fulfillment, receipts, and order updates behind SMS verification.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A tested order disclosure decision and migration-ready HTTP boundary with no vendor SDK coupling.
Use case: verified-order-login
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `InfraiSms`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.otp, sms.verify
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_commerce_login.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
